title: rk generated-artifact manifest (v1)
description: `.rk/generated.json` — the declared manifest src/gates/freshness.ts (Gate 7, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md M2.6, docs/gate-contracts.md's Gate 7 section) reads: one entry per generated artifact a repo has adopted the freshness mechanism for. Untrusted, hand-editable JSON, same edge-trust posture as .rk/config.json — a malformed manifest is never a crash and never a silent no-op; the gate reports one ERROR per malformation. Optional file: its total absence is a legitimate, presence-conditional green state (the mechanism simply has not been adopted), never a finding.

schema_version.description: A version bump accompanies any incompatible shape change (CLAUDE.md rule 10), with a fixture.

entries.description: One row per adopted generated artifact. Order is not significant; the gate reports findings in array order.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the generated artifact, e.g. "argument/INDEX.md".

generator.description: Generator id this rk binary must recognize to regenerate `path`. Known ids as of M2.6: "linker-index" (argument/INDEX.md's render), "linker-dag" (argument/DAG.md's render) — src/gates/freshness.ts's GENERATORS map. An id this binary does not recognize is reported as 'not adopted' on the gate's coverage line, never silently dropped and never an ERROR by itself (see docs/gate-contracts.md's Gate 7 section).
